name: Descope
tagline: Passwordless auth and identity platform API for passkeys, SSO, and MFA
description: Descope is a modern authentication and identity platform API that provides passwordless login (passkeys, magic links, OTPs), social login, enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA, session management, and user management. Positioned as a 2020s alternative to Auth0/Okta for developers building secure auth flows without maintaining identity infrastructure.

auth.details: Project ID and Management Key (or access key) sent via Authorization header; see docs for exact header format

use_cases: authenticate users with passkeys or magic links
manage users and tenants via management API
